Subject: Terms capture and intake for Aperture Data — MSA + Order Form

Hi team,

Quick heads up — Aperture Data (prospect) has signaled intent to pilot next quarter and will need an MSA + order form. Sales meeting today went well; they sent a short list of contractual asks that I captured below.

High-level asks from buyer:
- Limit indemnity to direct damages and carve out consequential.
- Data residency requirement: customer wants EU-only processing for certain workloads (may be narrow).
- Desired SLA: 99.9% for API, with credits tied to monthly availability.
- Requesting rolling 30-day trial credits and a 60-day payment term.

Attached to this thread will be their redline PDF once they send it. Can legal run a quick intake and tell us: (1) high-risk items, (2) what we can accept in sales motion, and (3) what needs commercial sign-off?

Proposed internal next steps:
1) Kimberly: capture party details and billing contact (I grabbed initial info but please confirm).
2) Markus: highlight any tech/regulatory flags on data residency.
3) Laura: initial redline review and Triage list by EOD Wed if possible.

I'll forward their email when it arrives. Thanks — Jonas

--
Jonas Weber

Thanks Jonas — adding a couple of party/billing notes here for intake:
- Legal entity: Aperture Data, Inc. (US HQ in Austin, tax id redacted)
- Primary PO/billing contact: Emily Chen (emily.chen@aperturedata.com, +1 512-555-0136)
- Expected initial seats: 5 instances, estimated monthly token volume callout in attached sheet.

I'll prepare a short party-sheet and attach to the HubSpot record.

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@aperturedata.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aperture Data Legal <legal@aperturedata.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 08:45:00 -0400
Subject: Aperture Data — initial redlines and questions (attached)

Jonas / Laura —

Thanks for the conversation earlier. Please find attached our initial redlines to the redlined MSA and order form (PDF attached: Aperture_Redlines_20250729.pdf). Main asks summarized here to help triage:

1) Indemnity: limit to claims arising from our direct use; remove third-party indemnity for actions outside Aperture's control.
2) Data residency & processing: require Redwood to process certain customer datasets in EU only; include audit right for that environment.
3) SLA credits: proposed SLA language includes uptime schedule and credits up to 50% for prolonged outages.
4) Security evidence: they asked for SOC 2 Type II report and an encryption-at-rest attestation.

We would like to move quickly — can you provide a redline back with the items you cannot accept and alternative language by EOD Friday? Also include a short note on how Redwood would operate EU-only workloads (if that requires Dedicated or an on-prem option).

Thanks,
Emily Chen
Head of Procurement | Aperture Data
emily.chen@aperturedata.com | +1 512-555-0136

Attachments: Aperture_Redlines_20250729.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Aperture Data — initial redlines and questions (attached)

Laura / Legal team — forwarding Aperture's redlines. Short summary for prioritization:
- Indemnity: Aperture is pushing to narrow our indemnity; likely negotiable but expect commercial pushback if we expand beyond direct damages.
- Data residency: this is the higher lift — they want EU-only processing for a subset of datasets. Markus, please outline operational approaches (Dedicated pool in EU region vs hybrid routing) and an estimated uplift in cost.
- SLA credits: their ask is aggressive; propose we convert to a tiered credit schedule and cap total credits to a smaller percentage.
- Evidence: they requested SOC 2 Type II — Kimberly, I confirmed we can share current report and the encryption attestation.

Ask: Laura, can you provide a triage (Accept / Commercial Approval Required / Decline) for each redline by COB Friday? If legal needs a call with Aperture's counsel, let's flag availability.

Proposed mutual action plan for sales <> legal <> ops:
- Thu: Legal triage + short redline back on core deal points.
- Thu-Fri: Ops to confirm technical feasibility & cost uplift for EU-only processing.
- Mon: Follow-up with Aperture to align on acceptable language and next steps (DocuSign timeline).

Thanks — I'll keep Emily in the loop after we have legal feedback.

Jonas
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
